messages.content: You are an expert competitive programmer. Produce a correct and efficient Python solution.

Solve this competitive programming problem in Python 3.10. Return the complete solution in one ```python``` block.

Problem:
#Description

Everybody has probably heard of the animal heads and legs problem from the earlier years at school. It goes:

```“A farm contains chickens and cows. There are x heads and y legs. How many chickens and cows are there?” ```

Where x <= 1000 and y <=1000

#Task

Assuming there are no other types of animals, work out how many of each animal are there. 

```Return a tuple in Python - (chickens, cows) and an array list - [chickens, cows]/{chickens, cows} in all other languages```

If either the heads & legs is negative, the result of your calculation is negative or the calculation is a float return "No solutions" (no valid cases).

In the form:
```python
(Heads, Legs) = (72, 200)

VALID - (72, 200) =>             (44 , 28) 
                             (Chickens, Cows)

INVALID - (72, 201) => "No solutions"
```

However, ```if 0 heads and 0 legs are given always return [0, 0]``` since zero heads must give zero animals.

There are many different ways to solve this, but they all give the same answer.

You will only be given integers types - however negative values (edge cases) will be given. 

Happy coding!

Starter code / required signature:
def animals(heads, legs):
	

Use the required function/method named animals. Preserve the required class and signature; do not read stdin.

Think carefully about correctness, edge cases and time/memory complexity.
